advisor_email_en.subject: Weekly Research Update (W47): Synthetic Eligibility Audit and Benchmark Framing
advisor_email_en.body:
Dear Advisor,

This week I completed the synthetic data-eligibility audit on the candidate selectivity panels and organized the literature baseline without initiating any formal model training yet. Specifically, we verified measurement boundary types (exact points vs. right-censored inequalities) and counted multi-ligand congeneric scaffold series across candidate routes. Broad screening panels contain very few scaffolds with three or more bilateral ligands, indicating that series coverage is the primary structural constraint prior to choosing transfer baselines. Meanwhile, our synthetic power diagnostics confirm that at least twelve independent series are required for stable error bounds.

No formal endpoints, thresholds, or final test splits have been locked yet. Next week, I will prepare a concise side-by-side comparison across multi-series medicinal chemistry candidates and broad single-panel benchmarks, validate synthetic positive and null evaluation controls locally, and meet to align on the target/off-target system and primary endpoint before freezing the protocol. If our schedule shifts, I will first finalize the multi-route diagnostic comparison locally.

Best regards,
Researcher
